lessons.title: Cockpit Familiarisation
lessons.subtitle: Round-dial instruments · controls, panel and switches

lessons.title: Straight & Level, Climbs & Descents
lessons.subtitle: Trim · speed changes · level-offs · glide
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 2,500 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. MAVIS flies it first, then you fly level, trim, change speed, climb and descend to set heights, and glide. No landing.

lessons.title: Effects of Controls
lessons.subtitle: Pitch, roll, yaw, power · primary & secondary effects
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 2,500 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. MAVIS flies it first, then you try the stick, pedals and throttle. No landing.

lessons.title: Slow Flight & Stalls
lessons.subtitle: Slow flight & turns · power-off, power-on and flaps-down stalls
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 3,500 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. MAVIS flies the slow flight and turns first, then it's your turn. No landing.

lessons.title: Steep Turns
lessons.subtitle: 30° warm-up · 45° turns · steady bank
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 3,000 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. MAVIS flies the 30° turns first, then it's your turn. No landing.

lessons.title: Flight Familiarization
lessons.subtitle: Airborne start · get a feel for the aircraft
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 2,500 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. Follow the to-do list, then point the nose at Paya Lebar. No landing.

lessons.title: Take-off
lessons.subtitle: Full power · rotate · climb out
lessons.start_note: Starts lined up on runway 02 at Paya Lebar. Take off and climb straight ahead to 1,000 ft, then you're put back on the runway.

lessons.title: Landing
lessons.subtitle: Final approach · flare · touchdown
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air on a 1.5 nm final for runway 02 at Paya Lebar. Fly the approach and land, rolling out to a stop.

lessons.title: Go-Around
lessons.subtitle: Rejected landing · power · flap sequence
lessons.start_note: Starts lined up on runway 02 at Paya Lebar. Fly the circuit and come down to land; MAVIS calls go around somewhere below 300 ft. Full power, flaps up in stages, climb straight ahead to 1,000 ft, and the lesson ends.

lessons.title: Short-Field Landing
lessons.subtitle: Stabilised approach · spot landing
lessons.start_note: Starts lined up on runway 02 at Paya Lebar. Fly the circuit, then a 61-knot approach onto the big white aiming-point markings about 400 m in, and stop within 450 m. MAVIS counts the distance down.

lessons.title: Soft-Field Technique
lessons.subtitle: Soft take-off and landing roll
lessons.start_note: Starts lined up on runway 02 at Paya Lebar. Soft-field take-off (nose wheel off early, accelerate just above the runway), the circuit, then a slow nose-high landing with the nose wheel held off.

lessons.title: Map Reading & Pilotage
lessons.subtitle: Landmark to landmark · note the time
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 1,500 ft, over the water south of Marina Bay. Fly to three landmarks, then find Paya Lebar and point at it. No landing.

lessons.title: Diversion
lessons.subtitle: Divert to Seletar · lost procedure
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 2,000 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. Divert to Seletar, then practise being lost and find Paya Lebar. No landing.

lessons.title: Partial Panel Flying
lessons.subtitle: Vacuum failure · timed turns · compass
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 3,000 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. The vacuum system fails: have some paper ready to cover the attitude and heading gauges. No landing.

lessons.title: Unusual Attitude Recovery
lessons.subtitle: Nose high / nose low · recovery order
lessons.start_note: Starts in the air at about 4,000 ft, 3 nm south of Paya Lebar. MAVIS talks you through it first, then puts you nose high or nose low four times and you recover. No landing.
